summary: 5 high-priority moves to make now, 13 total — ranked by impact on your rankings.

recommendations.title: Claim your Tier-1 local citations (0/5 live)
recommendations.why: Google Business Profile alone is ~32% of local-pack ranking, yet 24 of your 24 citations are still pending. Highest-leverage move for a Nagpur-area academy.
recommendations.action: Open the Backlink Agent → submit Google Business Profile, Bing Places & JustDial first with byte-for-byte identical NAP.

recommendations.title: Run a Google review acquisition system
recommendations.why: Review quantity, recency and response-rate are active local ranking signals — review velocity matters as much as total count. Reviews also lift AI-answer citation rate dramatically (≈1% with none → ≈53% with even a handful).
recommendations.action: Ask every student for a Google review at course completion (QR code + short link), aim for 4–8/month, and reply to all reviews within 24h.

recommendations.title: Confirm Google Search Console data is flowing
recommendations.why: The dashboard still shows 0 tracked keywords. If you just connected GSC, data takes 2–3 days to populate; if it stays empty, the service-account credential or sitemap submission needs fixing. Without it the engine can't find striking-distance keywords or measure progress.
recommendations.action: Verify the property, ensure the service-account credential is set, submit the sitemap, then re-check in 2–3 days.

recommendations.title: Cited in 0 of 3 AI answer checks — fix it
recommendations.why: AI answer engines decide which brands to surface. Review profiles are the strongest lever; answer-first, intro-loaded content matters too — 44% of AI citations come from the first 30% of a page.
recommendations.action: Build the review profile (above), add author/Org credentials (E-E-A-T), and lead each key page with a direct 1–2 sentence answer before the detail.

recommendations.title: Resolve 1 critical technical issue
recommendations.why: Critical issues (indexability, broken meta, schema errors) directly block ranking. Clear these before investing in content.
recommendations.action: The auto-fixer handles most; the rest are flagged for manual action.

recommendations.title: Work your Google Business Profile weekly
recommendations.why: GBP is a living ranking signal, not a set-and-forget listing. Weekly Google Posts, fully populated Products/Services, fresh photos, prompt messaging and answered Q&A all feed the local algorithm.
recommendations.action: Post a Google Update weekly, fill Products/Services with keyword-rich course descriptions, upload 3–5 photos/month, enable messaging, and seed the Q&A.

recommendations.title: Push your 64 pages for indexing
recommendations.why: Nothing submitted to Google/Bing yet. Faster indexing means new and updated pages start ranking sooner.
recommendations.action: Enable IndexNow + sitemap submission so every crawl auto-pings Google & Bing.

recommendations.title: Expand structured data (Course, LocalBusiness, Breadcrumb, Review)
recommendations.why: You already ship FAQ + Organization schema. For an academy, Course schema makes courses eligible for rich results, AggregateRating shows ⭐ stars in the SERP (big CTR lift), and LocalBusiness + BreadcrumbList strengthen local + navigation signals.
recommendations.action: Add Course schema to each course page, AggregateRating from your Google reviews, LocalBusiness on contact/home, and BreadcrumbList sitewide.

recommendations.title: Track & fix Core Web Vitals (LCP / INP / CLS)
recommendations.why: INP is the most-failed Core Web Vital in 2026 — 43% of sites miss the 200ms target. Targets: LCP < 2.5s, INP < 200ms, CLS < 0.1. Passing all three cuts bounce ~24%.
recommendations.action: Wire the PageSpeed/CrUX solver into the daily run. Quick wins: explicit width/height on images, defer non-critical JS, preload the hero image.

recommendations.title: Strengthen E-E-A-T signals
recommendations.why: Trust is now the primary filter for AI inclusion and a growing ranking factor. Real author identities, credentials, and social proof tell Google and LLMs you are a credible source.
recommendations.action: Add author bios with credentials to every post, a detailed About page (founder, faculty, accreditations), student testimonials, and link real social profiles.

recommendations.title: Refresh existing content on a schedule
recommendations.why: Freshness is a ranking signal and re-engages AI crawlers. Updating proven pages is far cheaper than writing new ones and often recovers slipping rankings.
recommendations.action: Each month, update your 5 highest-impression pages: new stats/year, expanded answers, refreshed examples, and an updated "last modified" date.

recommendations.title: Target featured snippets & "People Also Ask"
recommendations.why: Snippet/PAA answers win position-zero visibility and are the exact format AI answer engines lift. Structured Q&A content is dual-purpose for SEO and AEO.
recommendations.action: For each target query add a concise 40–55 word direct answer under a question heading, plus a short list/table where it fits.

recommendations.title: Build topical authority with content clusters
recommendations.why: Depth and topical coverage win both classic rankings and AI citations. A pillar page + supporting cluster, richly interlinked, signals expertise (the first "E" in E-E-A-T).
recommendations.action: Group target keywords into 3–5 clusters (e.g. "digital marketing course", "SEO training", "PPC course"); publish one pillar + 4–6 supporting posts each, all interlinked.
